target: Amenaza superior natural de las Aguas de Lethra; gran depredador anfibio.
art_direction: Gran depredador anfibio largo y pesado cuya espalda rugosa se confunde con barro y vegetación. Debe leerse como animal de emboscada de canales profundos, no cocodrilo literal ni monstruo fantástico.
prompt: Create a wide natural scene in the Aguas de Lethra showing one adult Dorsalodo partly emerging from a quiet deep channel. Long heavy amphibious body, broad low head, rough irregular back carrying wet mud and incidental plant matter as camouflage, powerful body adapted to water and muddy banks. Its outline should initially blend with the bank before becoming readable as a large predator. Reeds are flattened along a broad entry to the water and a heavy drag mark is visible. Humid muted greens, mud browns and gray water, natural overcast light.
negative_constraints: Do not depict a literal crocodile, alligator, hippo or giant salamander
No dorsal spikes, horns, armor plates or fantasy fins
No magic, glow, Arcane traits or bioluminescence
No attack toward camera or gore
Vegetation on back is incidental camouflage, not a growing forest
canon_sources: vintage-telnet/CREATURES.md — Aguas de Lethra / Amenaza superior: Dorsalodo
notes: Amenaza superior canónica; mantener lectura anfibia y de emboscada.
